nodes.name: CoOOH Electrochemical Deposition
nodes.procedure: Ni foam was ultrasonically cleaned in 3.0 M HCl solution for 10 min (53 kHz, 75%), then cleaned five times in deionized water. Electrochemical deposition was performed in 100 mL aqueous solution containing 1.455 g Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O using Ni foam (1×2 cm²) as working electrode, carbon rod as counter electrode, Ag/AgCl as reference electrode. Anodic treatment at 20 mA cm⁻² for 600 s, then cathodic deposition at -20 mA cm⁻² for 600 s to obtain Co(OH)₂. Co(OH)₂ was electrochemically pretreated under oxidative potentials (1.10-1.80 V vs RHE) for ten cycles to obtain CoOOH.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of CoOOH. The CoOOH was synthesized by electrochemical oxidation of the Co(OH)₂... The mass loadings of CoOOH were 4.0 mg cm⁻² measured by ICP-AES.

nodes.name: Ru_T/CoOOH Wet Impregnation
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared CoOOH were placed in a beaker with 170 mL of deionized water. Then, 30 mL solution containing 16 mg RuCl₃·xH₂O was injected into the beaker through a micro-injection pump (10 mL/h) under a continued stir (750 rpm). Then, the mixed solution was stirred for 10 h at room temperature. After isolation by centrifugation, the precipitates were washed three times with deionized water and ethanol, respectively. Finally, the product was freeze-dried in a vacuum freeze dryer for 8.0 h.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Ru_T/CoOOH section in Methods

nodes.name: RuTIrV/CoOOH Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Ni foam loaded Ru_T/CoOOH was used as working electrode in three-electrode system with carbon rod counter electrode and Ag/AgCl reference electrode. Working electrode pretreated by linear sweep 1.10-1.80 V for five cycles. Added 0.25 mL 100 μM IrCl₄·xH₂O, mixed 10 min under stirring. Electrochemical deposition by linear sweep 1.10-1.80 V at 5 mV s⁻¹ for one cycle. Collected by ultrasonication and washed with ethanol.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of RuTIrV/CoOOH. The RuTIrV/CoOOH were synthesized by an electrochemical deposition method... The mass loadings... were about 4.4, 4.0, 0.2, and 0.2 mg cm⁻² measured by ICP-AES.

nodes.name: IrV/CoOOH Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Similar procedures as RuTIrV/CoOOH synthesis except using CoOOH instead of Ru_T/CoOOH as support.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Ir_V/CoOOH. IrV/CoOOH was synthesized via similar procedures as synthesizing RuTIrV/CoOOH except for changing the support from Ru_T/CoOOH to CoOOH.

nodes.name: Ir_T/CoOOH Wet Impregnation
nodes.procedure: Similar to Ru_T/CoOOH synthesis except using 30 mL solution containing 8 mg IrCl₄·xH₂O as precursor.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Ir_T/CoOOH. The synthesis of Ir_T/CoOOH was similar to that of Ru_T/CoOOH except that the single-atom precursor was a 30 mL solution containing 8 mg IrCl₄·xH₂O.

nodes.name: Ir_T Ru_V/CoOOH Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Similar to RuTIrV/CoOOH synthesis except using Ir_T/CoOOH instead of Ru_T/CoOOH as support and 0.50 mL 100 μM RuCl₃·xH₂O as Ru precursor.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Ir_T Ru_V/CoOOH. The synthesis process... was similar to that of Ru_T Ir_V/CoOOH except for changing the support from Ru_T/CoOOH to Ir_T/CoOOH.
